info.title: QR Api Universal API
info.description: Generate static QR codes for URLs, text, vCards, WiFi networks, map locations, phone calls, email, and SMS using QR Api's REST API.

post.description: Creates a QR code for an email address in QR Api.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

address.description: Email address to encode in the QR code.

size.description: QR code size preset: s, m, l, xl, xxl, xxxl, or custom.

format.description: QR code output format: png, jpg, svg, pdf, or eps.

data.description: PNG image bytes for the generated QR code.

type.description: Node buffer marker for the generated QR code image.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
